item.name: E3 Owner-driver DOB / gender correction - PCAR

exec: const P=pm.response.json();const risk=P.PolicyLobList[0].PolicyRiskList[0];const u=Date.now()%100000;let n=0;risk.PolicyCoverageList.forEach(cv=>(cv.PolicyBenefitList||[]).forEach(b=>{if(['NPPA','ADPAPAS'].includes(b.ProductElementCode)){b.PersonName='Nominee '+u;b.RelationWithInsured='Friend';n++;}}));if(!n){throw new Error('no nominee benefit');}pm.collectionVariables.set('endoBody',JSON.stringify({PolicyNo:pm.collectionVariables.get('policyNo_PCAR'),EndoType:'1',EndoSubType:'11',EndorsementPaymentInfoList:[{PayModeCode:100}],NewPolicy:P}));
